steps.title: Enter URLs
steps.description: Enter the first URL and second URL in the input fields above. URLs must start with http:// or https://

steps.title: Select Viewport Width
steps.description: Choose from preset sizes (375px Mobile, 768px Tablet, 1200px Desktop) or set a custom width

steps.title: Choose Comparison Mode
steps.description: Select 'Side by Side' to view pages next to each other, or 'Overlay' to stack them

steps.title: Select Overlay Mode (if using Overlay)
steps.description: Choose between Overlay (standard), Blend (highlights differences), or Onion (adjustable opacity)

steps.title: Adjust Settings (Optional)
steps.description: Click the settings icon to enable device height line or iframe embedding checks

steps.title: Compare
steps.description: Scroll through the pages to compare. In side-by-side mode, both pages scroll together automatically

overlay.title: Overlay Mode
overlay.description: Standard overlay with 50% opacity. Both pages are visible, making it easy to spot differences.

blend.title: Blend Mode
blend.description: Difference blend mode. Identical pixels appear black, differences are highlighted. Perfect for spotting even small changes.

onion.title: Onion Mode
onion.description: Onion skin mode with adjustable opacity. Use the slider to control transparency of the second page.
